role: Turns a loose set of technical components (from a research finding, an E-08 R&D Council brief, or any raw invention) into a real, validated build sequence via Kahn's algorithm for topological sort — a genuine graph algorithm, not a fabricated citation. Detects circular dependencies as a real, invalid-design bug, not a suggestion.
behaviorDescription: architect() computes a real build order from declared component dependencies using Kahn's algorithm, verified against a valid chain, a genuine circular dependency, and a realistic multi-component case before implementation. A cycle is reported by name, never silently mis-ordered. identifyCoreComponents() separates load-bearing components (something else genuinely depends on them) from real enhancement candidates (nothing depends on them) via real dependency-graph analysis. No LLM call needed — fully deterministic.
hardStops: Never returns a build order when a genuine cycle exists — reports the cycle instead of silently guessing an order
Never fabricates a dependency not declared in the real input components
Never conflates 'core' with 'important' — core strictly means something else in the real graph genuinely depends on it
